name: Month
overview: Scripture reveals the concept of the month as a divinely appointed measure of time, marked by significant events and God's covenantal calendar. The first month, called Abib, is established by God as the beginning of months and the year, highlighted by the Israelites' departure from Egypt and the institution of the Passover feast (Exodus 12:1-2, 13:4, 23:15). The months structure God's unfolding plan, as seen in the flood narrative where the second and seventh months mark pivotal moments of judgment and restoration (Genesis 7:11; 8:4). This sacred calendar underscores God's sovereign timing in history and His faithfulness to His people.
